schema.description: Service associated with this SRV record.

schema.name: weight
schema.description: Weight. A relative value applicable for records with the same priority. A lower number is preferred.

schema.name: text
schema.description: The text value associated with this TXT DNS record. Text can contain up to four 255-character strings. Lines containing commas must be enclosed in double quotes (").

local.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/proxy/network/integration/v1/sites/{siteId}/dns/policies/{dnsPolicyId}", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Get DNS Policy
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.network:
    path: "/v1/sites/{siteId}/dns/policies/{dnsPolicyId}"
    method: GET
  register: result

- debug:
    var: result.data
